t: The classic 8-bit chip inside the Arduino Uno and Nano.
steps: Buy an Arduino Uno R3 or Nano from the Arduino store or a maker shop.
Get a USB cable that fits the board. The Uno uses a square USB-B plug.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Some clone boards use a CH340 USB chip. Install its driver on older computers.
Plug in the board and choose Arduino Uno from the board menu.
Open the Blink example and press Upload. The small light on the board starts to blink.
Try a button and an LED on a breadboard for your first circuit.
